G3_faithfulness.justification: Because the determinant is \(uv(e_v-e_u)\) with positive distinct emitter indices, invertibility is exactly equivalent to requiring \(e_u\ne e_v\), matching the original three-shift coloring task.

G4_naturalness.justification: The statement is grammatically clear but uses contrived quantum terminology and an awkward reference to a “linearly independent configuration with their indices.”
